Body charcoal-black with subtle dark woad blue cast, same dark body as the Spade. Warm painted bronze/gold double outline and restrained interlace ribbon tracing the INSIDE of the whole suit contour. No triskele in the central medallion. Redistribute ornament naturally to fit this suit without crowding the outline. Same palette/materials and hand-painted ink/gouache, same warm restrained shading. Use each lobe to contain some organized oak/interlace ornament without losing its rounded club outline.
Actual transparent RGBA alpha OUTSIDE the silhouette, opaque body throughout INSIDE, no white box, no painted checkerboard, no hole through body, no drop shadow or glow. All ornament within the contour, no outside foliage. One clubs pip only, no reference spade in output, no collage, no border/card, no text, no ranks, no numerals, no people, no background, no runes, tartan, shamrocks, lotus, flower rosette, turquoise jewel, modern 3D metal or watermark.
